E1.name: Insufficient balance
E1.evidence: CLI submitted $300 FAK order with only ~$1.56 USD1. No pre-flight balance check. Order was silently cancelled by exchange. No structured error about insufficient funds — an AI agent cannot distinguish balance failure from other cancellation reasons.

E4.output:
Error: {"ok":false,"error":"MYRIAD API request failed (404): Market not found"}
Recovery: USD1=1.563549 returned successfully
E4.evidence: Invalid market returns structured 404 error. Subsequent balance query succeeds immediately — no state corruption.

gradeReason: 16/18 checks passed. Two failures: (1) D3 orderbook depth has only 1 ask level vs required 5+ per side — this is a market liquidity issue, not a tool defect; (2) E1 insufficient balance order is silently cancelled rather than returning a structured error — this is a real tool deficiency that would confuse an AI trading agent. All trading operations (preview, limit, cancel, market buy, sell) worked flawlessly on first attempt. JSON output is consistently structured across all commands.
keyFindings: Excellent JSON output quality — every command returns structured, parseable JSON with consistent schemas
Full trading lifecycle works: dry-run preview, limit order, cancel, market buy, market sell all succeeded on first attempt
Orderbook mode (ob) uses USD1 collateral with maker 0bps / taker 73bps fee structure
FAK (Fill-And-Kill) time-in-force for market orders with --wait-ms polling for fill confirmation
GTC (Good-Til-Cancelled) for limit orders, cancel works reliably
Dry-run mode provides detailed market quotes with level-by-level breakdown
Input validation is solid: zero, negative values all return clear error messages
CLI self-describes as 'for AI agents' — well-suited for programmatic use
MCP server mode available via 'mcp' command for tool integration
Only 1 active orderbook market during testing — limited market coverage
blockers: E1: No pre-flight balance check on orderbook orders. A $300 order with $1.56 balance is submitted and silently cancelled. An AI agent cannot programmatically determine the failure reason. Should return a structured error like {"ok":false,"error":"Insufficient USD1 balance. Required: 315, Available: 1.56"} before submission.
